locked_description: A robed figure mutters over guttering candles in a flooded lecture hall. Some say the old mage school still floats, somewhere past the Chao Phraya barricades.
unlocked_description: Before the flood, magic was a rumor. After, it was a survival skill. The Apprentice Mage channels raw arcane current through improvised foci: broken phone glass, rebar, prayer beads.
playstyle: Spell-chain caster: consecutive Spell cards stack rising damage.
evolution_hint: The river remembers those who fall into it with intent left unspoken.

unlocked_description: You did not choose to fall into the river outside the old mage school. It chose you. Scales climb your forearms now, and your spells taste of silt and old temple gold.
playstyle: Tide caster: Spell chains hit harder and the resource pool doubles, letting long chains run longer.

locked_description: Someone is tracking monster spoor across the collapsed BTS line, moving like they've done this before, in a life they don't talk about.
unlocked_description: Licensed by the Bangkok Hunter Association, or unlicensed, more likely. The Rookie Hunter fights in bursts: strike, strike, strike, then a heartbeat to breathe.
playstyle: Action-chain brawler: consecutive Action cards stack rising damage.
evolution_hint: The canals near Klong Toey have started answering back to those who hunt too deep.

locked_description: In the refugee towers, one name gets whispered when the fever runs high and the clinics have no more medicine to give.
unlocked_description: Science hit its ceiling. Prayer picked up where it stopped. The Field Medic mends flesh with light borrowed from something that shouldn't answer, but does.
playstyle: Power-chain support: Power cards build toward strong shields, freeing Spell cards to heal.
evolution_hint: Some say the dead in the refugee towers speak clearest to whoever tends the sickest of the living.

unlocked_description: The crocodile that should have killed you in the Klong Toey canal didn't. It just wanted to know you'd survive being it.
playstyle: Action-chain brawler evolved: consecutive Action cards stack rising damage, backed by tougher hide and an ambush setup.

unlocked_description: The ancestors you prayed to for the sick started praying back. Now they lend you their hands when yours aren't enough.
playstyle: Power-chain support evolved: Power cards build stronger shields and unlock a heavier heal.

locked_description: Someone's been diving the flooded basements of Wat Hualamphong for salvage, and the drowned don't seem to mind them passing.
unlocked_description: The dead down there stopped fighting the current a long time ago. You didn't ask them to follow you back up. They just did.
playstyle: Spell-chain drainer: consecutive Spell cards stack rising damage, paid for by borrowing strength from the dead.
evolution_hint: The flood outside Wat Hualamphong doesn't take the dead anymore. Some say it's waiting to give them back to the right person.

unlocked_description: The current outside Wat Hualamphong doesn't take the dead anymore. It gives them back, and they answer to you now.
playstyle: Command a tide of the drowned dead: Spell chains hit harder and Power cards raise temporary thralls as block.

locked_description: Nobody's seen their face. The debt collectors who go looking for them in Bang Rak don't come back with a good story.
unlocked_description: You learned to move like the city forgot you were there. Sometimes it still does.
playstyle: Action-chain burst: low-cost strikes chain fast, trading survivability for tempo.
evolution_hint: The guardian statue at the drowned temple in Thonburi has been missing an arm since the flood. It's looking for one.

unlocked_description: The temple guardian statue in the drowned wat didn't fall on you by accident. Something in it decided you'd make a better vessel than a ruin.
playstyle: Demon-guardian burst: Action chains hit harder and a Power card grants a brief, fearsome counter-stance.

locked_description: Ex-flood-relief riot police, still carrying a service shield nobody issued anymore. Stands between people and whatever's coming, every time.
unlocked_description: Nobody told you to keep the line after the department stopped existing. You just did. Somebody has to.
playstyle: Power-chain wall: Power cards build heavy, stacking block; damage output is modest but reliable.
evolution_hint: The shrine at the flooded intersection on Ratchaprasong never quite washed away. It's still waiting for someone stubborn enough to guard it.

unlocked_description: The shrine at the flooded intersection didn't wash away. It waited for someone stubborn enough to keep standing in front of it, and gave them three heads' worth of will.
playstyle: Fortress evolved: Power chains stack very high block, and the guardian is far harder to wear down.

locked_description: Fights bare-knuckle in the flooded fight pits under the old expressway for whatever the crowd throws. Hasn't lost yet. Hasn't really tried not to get hurt, either.
unlocked_description: You stopped feeling the punches somewhere around fight forty. That should probably worry you more than it does.
playstyle: Action-chain glass cannon: consecutive Action cards stack fast and hit hard, with little defense to fall back on.
evolution_hint: You wore a demon-king mask into the pit once, as a joke. The crowd swears your fights got harder to watch after that.

unlocked_description: The demon-king mask you wore into the pit as a joke stopped being a costume around fight sixty. Now you're not entirely sure where you end and the mask begins.
playstyle: Demon-king rage evolved: Action chains hit much harder, at the cost of thinner defenses.

locked_description: Somebody's still tending a little spirit house on a rooftop garden in Thonburi, offering rice to something that started offering things back.
unlocked_description: You just wanted the san phra phum to stop looking so lonely up there. You didn't expect it to start listening.
playstyle: Power-chain summoner: Power cards call small spirits that soak hits and set up a Spell finisher.
evolution_hint: The spirit house has been getting fuller offerings than you've been leaving it. Something's been helping out.

unlocked_description: The spirit house is empty now. What was in it doesn't need it anymore; it just needs you to keep calling it 'little brother.'
playstyle: Bonded child-spirit evolved: Power chains grant strong block and unlock a devastating shared strike.

locked_description: Dives the flooded fuel depots off Rama IV for scavenge. Came up from one with burns that healed wrong, and a lighter that never runs out of flame.
unlocked_description: The depot fire that should have killed you left something behind instead. It's been waiting under your skin ever since.
playstyle: Spell-chain burst caster: consecutive Spell cards stack rising fire damage, hard-hitting but fragile.
evolution_hint: The mural of Garuda on the old palace wall spent six years underwater. Divers say it isn't faded at all.

unlocked_description: The mural of Garuda on the old palace wall was underwater for six years. It isn't anymore, not on you. Your fire flies now.
playstyle: Sun-eagle caster evolved: Spell chains hit much harder, channeling a national myth's fire.

locked_description: Someone's running the skybridges between towers at speeds that shouldn't be possible on foot, picking off monsters from ranges nobody else can hit.
unlocked_description: You learned every skybridge in the district by the time you were sure you'd never see the ground again. Turns out that's a survival skill now.
playstyle: Action-chain skirmisher: fast, low-cost strikes chain easily, favoring tempo over raw power.
evolution_hint: You made a jump between towers once that no scout should survive. Something caught you the rest of the way.

unlocked_description: You made a jump between towers that no living scout should have survived. Something with a very old, very fond memory of impossible leaps carried you the rest of the way.
playstyle: Monkey-god speed evolved: Action chains hit faster and harder than almost any other class.

locked_description: Trains at dawn on a half-sunk boxing platform by the klong, throwing elbows at nothing anyone else can see. The nothing usually loses.
unlocked_description: Your kru always said the ring teaches you things you can't explain to people who've never stood in one. He didn't mean it literally. You're pretty sure he didn't.
playstyle: Action-chain striker: cheap, rapid strikes chain into a defensive Power card, classic Muay Thai rhythm.
evolution_hint: The tattooist in the flooded shophouse said the sacred ink wouldn't take on someone who'd broken as many bones as you had. She was wrong.

unlocked_description: The old tattooist in the flooded shophouse said the ink wouldn't take on someone who'd already broken as many bones as you had. She was wrong, and so were you, about a lot of things.
playstyle: Sacred-tattoo striker evolved: Action chains hit harder, empowered by yantra wards.

locked_description: Runs a stall in the flooded market selling concoctions that shouldn't work as well as they do, mixed from things scavenged out of old pharmacies and worse places.
unlocked_description: Turns out pre-flood chemistry plus whatever's in the water now makes something new. You've just been the only one desperate enough to keep drinking your own experiments.
playstyle: Volatile spell-and-power mixer: Power cards prime a volatile brew that the next Spell cashes in big.
evolution_hint: One batch went wrong in a way that didn't kill you. It just... stayed.

unlocked_description: One batch went wrong in a way that didn't kill you. It just stayed. You can taste the mystic current in the water now, and you can bottle a little of it.
playstyle: Mystic-infused mixer evolved: Power setups pay off in much larger Spell bursts or heals.

locked_description: Got struck by something during the Release that wasn't lightning. People in the tower call them 'static head' and mostly keep their distance.
unlocked_description: You can hear the city thinking now, sometimes. Mostly it's just noise. Sometimes it's useful.
playstyle: Spell-chain telekinetic: consecutive Spell cards stack, with a Power card to brace against feedback.
evolution_hint: The noise in your head hasn't been noise for a while now. Something in the current under the city is starting to answer back.

unlocked_description: The noise stopped being noise. Somewhere between the flood and now, you started resonating with whatever the Release actually was, and it started listening back.
playstyle: Full telekinetic evolved: Spell chains scale hard, and the Resonant can shield through sheer force of will.

locked_description: Never finished temple training before the flood hit. Still goes where the vengeful spirits gather anyway, chanting half-remembered sutras and hoping they're enough.
unlocked_description: You never got your full ordination. The spirits you banish don't seem to care about the paperwork.
playstyle: Spell-chain purifier: consecutive Spell cards stack, paired with self-healing and a warding Power card.
evolution_hint: The old teacher who never finished training you didn't survive the flood. Somehow, the training kept going anyway.

unlocked_description: The old teacher who never finished training you didn't survive the flood. You finished it yourself, apparently, in the nine years since, without quite noticing.
playstyle: Full exorcist evolved: Spell chains scale up considerably, with a stronger self-heal and ward.

locked_description: Broadcasts something on the old emergency radio band at 3 a.m. from a tower nobody's supposed to still have power in. People who listen say it changes how they fight, after.
unlocked_description: The station went dead in 2026 along with everyone who ran it. You just plugged the mic back in one night and started talking. Something started talking back through you.
playstyle: Power-chain enabler: heavy on setup cards that empower a single big Spell finisher each turn.
evolution_hint: You haven't needed the transmitter for a few broadcasts now. You just aren't sure anyone's noticed that yet, including you.

unlocked_description: You don't need the transmitter anymore. You are the signal now, and half the towers in range can still hear you, whether they want to or not.
playstyle: Signal incarnate evolved: Power setups pay off in a devastating amplified Spell finisher.

unlocked_description: The naga's blood doesn't fight you for control anymore. It answers before you finish the thought.
playstyle: Spell-chain caster refined: a lingering Silt Curse now scars enemies with damage that keeps ticking.

unlocked_description: Fangs grew in where teeth used to be. You didn't ask for them, and lately you don't mind them either.
playstyle: Fusion caster: the deck splits between Spell current and Power scale-craft, a true hybrid of mage and naga.

unlocked_description: Half your reflection is still human. The rest has scales, and it's stopped hiding when the water's still.
playstyle: Half-transformed caster: a river-wide Tide Wave now catches every enemy in reach.

unlocked_description: The river outside the mage school doesn't remember a version of you that wasn't like this. Most days, neither do you.
playstyle: Mastery tier: every Spell lands harder for the same cost. The tide simply obeys now.

unlocked_description: You stopped falling into the river a long time ago. These days, when the water rises, it rises because you're in it.
playstyle: Full avatar: a single Drowning Judgment can end a fight outright against anything already wounded.

unlocked_description: The canal doesn't just tolerate you anymore. Things move out of your way down there now.
playstyle: Action-chain brawler refined: a Festering Bite now leaves a wound that keeps draining the target.

unlocked_description: Your canines came in wrong a while back. Sharper. You've stopped going to dentists about it.
playstyle: Fusion brawler: the kit splits between raw Action strikes and a Power-guarded ambush stance.

unlocked_description: Half your face doesn't move like a face is supposed to anymore. The other half still smiles, when it wants to.
playstyle: Half-transformed brawler: a Canal Frenzy now tears into every enemy caught nearby.

unlocked_description: The Klong Toey canal doesn't have monsters in it anymore. It just has you, and that's usually enough.
playstyle: Mastery tier: every strike lands like the first one always did, except it never stops.

unlocked_description: You don't hunt the canal anymore. Nine years on, the canal is just where you live, and everything in it knows your name.
playstyle: Full avatar: a single Death Roll Verdict can end anything already bleeding.

unlocked_description: The prayers you say over the sick don't feel like prayers anymore. They feel like conversations, and something's answering.
playstyle: Power-chain support refined: a Withering Rebuke now weakens whatever's threatening your patient over time.

unlocked_description: You stopped needing to ask permission to channel them a while ago. Now they just show up when you need the hands.
playstyle: Fusion support: the kit splits between Power-built shields and a Spell strike borrowed from the ancestors' patience running out.

unlocked_description: You can see the tower's dead now, not just hear them. Most of them just want to help. Most.
playstyle: Half-transformed support: an Ancestral Reckoning now protects and punishes everything in the fight at once.

unlocked_description: The refugee towers stopped whispering your name a while back. Now they just say it out loud, like it's always been true.
playstyle: Mastery tier: shields hold longer, heals land bigger, and the ancestors never seem to tire.

unlocked_description: You don't channel the ancestors anymore. Somewhere along the way, without quite noticing, you became one of the ones the next medium will pray to.
playstyle: Full avatar: a single Final Reckoning ends what's already failing, and nothing here fights alone anymore.

unlocked_description: The dead outside Wat Hualamphong don't just follow you back up anymore. They wait for you to ask.
playstyle: Spell-chain drainer refined: a Marrow Rot curse now keeps feeding on the target long after it lands.

unlocked_description: You stopped needing to dive for the dead a while ago. Now the flood just brings them to you.
playstyle: Fusion drainer: the kit splits between Spell current and a Power ward built from borrowed bone.

unlocked_description: Half of you stopped needing to breathe a while back. The other half still insists on it, out of habit.
playstyle: Half-transformed drainer: a Tide of the Drowned now drags every enemy in reach under with you.

unlocked_description: Wat Hualamphong doesn't flood anymore, not really. It just breathes, slowly, in and out, and you breathe with it.
playstyle: Mastery tier: every curse lands harder and lingers longer. The current has stopped fighting you back.

unlocked_description: You don't dive for the dead anymore. Nine years on, they surface for you, the way a court rises for a king it's still deciding whether to trust.
playstyle: Full avatar: a single Drowned King's Decree ends anything the tide has already claimed.

unlocked_description: The guardian statue's mark on your arm hasn't faded. If anything, it's gotten more detailed.
playstyle: Action-chain burst refined: a Cursed Edge wound now keeps bleeding long after the cut.

unlocked_description: Your reflection in still water doesn't quite match anymore. It's not wrong. It's just older than you.
playstyle: Fusion assassin: the kit splits between fast Action strikes and a Power-guarded demon stance.

unlocked_description: Half your shadow doesn't match your shape anymore, most nights. You've learned not to look at it directly.
playstyle: Half-transformed reaver: a Guardian's Wrath now cuts down every enemy in the room.

unlocked_description: The drowned wat in Thonburi doesn't need a statue anymore. It has you, and you don't mind the job.
playstyle: Mastery tier: every strike carries a guardian's full weight, and none of it costs more than it used to.

unlocked_description: You stopped being the statue's new vessel a long time ago. These days, when something needs guarding, the city just sends them to you.
playstyle: Full avatar: a single Guardian's Final Verdict ends anything already cornered.

unlocked_description: Three heads' worth of will doesn't get tired the way one does. You're starting to understand what that actually means.
playstyle: Power-chain wall refined: a Guardian's Brand now wears down anything foolish enough to keep attacking.

unlocked_description: You don't need the shrine anymore, not really. Wherever you plant your feet, that's the ground it's protecting now.
playstyle: Fusion guardian: the kit splits between a Power wall and an Action-tagged counter-charge.

unlocked_description: You don't fit through most doorways anymore, not comfortably. Nobody's complained yet. Nobody's tried.
playstyle: Half-transformed colossus: a Threefold Judgment now punishes every enemy that dared get close.

unlocked_description: The intersection at Ratchaprasong doesn't flood the way it used to. It just has you standing in it, and that seems to be enough.
playstyle: Mastery tier: block stacks higher than ever, and nothing gets through unnoticed anymore.

unlocked_description: You stopped guarding the shrine a long time ago. Nine years on, people just call the intersection by your name instead of the shrine's.
playstyle: Full avatar: a single Threefold Reckoning ends anything already failing to get past you.

unlocked_description: The mask doesn't come off clean anymore. There's a mark underneath now, whether or not you're wearing it.
playstyle: Action-chain glass cannon refined: a Demon's Grudge wound now keeps hurting long after the punch lands.

unlocked_description: You don't need the mask in the pit anymore. Half the time you forget to bring it, and nobody's noticed the difference.
playstyle: Fusion berserker: the kit splits between raw Action fury and a Power-guarded demon stance.

unlocked_description: Ten arms would be an exaggeration. Four isn't, most nights, and nobody in the pit argues about it anymore.
playstyle: Half-transformed ravager: a Tenfold Ruin now flattens every enemy in reach.

unlocked_description: The fight pit under the old expressway doesn't have a champion anymore. It just has you, and everyone else takes turns losing.
playstyle: Mastery tier: every strike lands with a king's full weight, and the fury never runs dry.

unlocked_description: You don't wear the mask into the pit anymore. Nine years on, the pit just clears out when it hears you coming, mask or not.
playstyle: Full avatar: a single King's Judgment ends anything already staggered.

unlocked_description: Little brother doesn't wait to be called anymore. He just shows up, usually right when you need him to.
playstyle: Power-chain summoner refined: a Mischief Curse now wears the enemy down while little brother keeps you safe.

unlocked_description: You stopped needing the spirit house months ago. These days he just follows, the way a little brother does.
playstyle: Fusion summoner: the kit splits between a Power-built bond and a Spell strike he lends you outright.

unlocked_description: Some days you're not entirely sure where you end and he begins. He seems to find that funnier than you do.
playstyle: Half-transformed conjurer: a Brotherhood's Reckoning now hits everything in the fight at once.

unlocked_description: The spirit house on the rooftop is long gone. You never needed to rebuild it. He was never really tied to the house.
playstyle: Mastery tier: the bond holds stronger than ever, and every strike lands with two sets of will behind it.

unlocked_description: You don't summon him anymore. Nine years on, when people say your name, half the time they mean both of you.
playstyle: Full avatar: a single Brothers' Verdict can end anything already reeling.

unlocked_description: The mural's fire doesn't just answer when you call it now. It's started answering before you finish asking.
playstyle: Spell-chain burst caster refined: a Sunscar Brand now keeps burning long after the initial blast.

unlocked_description: Something like feathers is starting to show at the edge of the burns. You've stopped trying to explain it to people.
playstyle: Fusion caster: the kit splits between Spell fire and a Power-guarded wingbeat of heat.

unlocked_description: You don't remember deciding to grow wings. You just remember the first time you used them, and not falling.
playstyle: Half-transformed flamebearer: a Sunwing Eruption now burns everything caught in the blast.

unlocked_description: The old palace mural doesn't flake anymore. Divers say it looks freshly painted, and they're right, in a way none of them expect.
playstyle: Mastery tier: every bolt lands with a myth's full weight, and the fire never seems to gutter.

unlocked_description: You don't channel the mural's fire anymore. Nine years on, when the sky over the flooded district catches light at dusk, people just say your name.
playstyle: Full avatar: a single Sun-Eagle's Verdict ends anything already scorched.

unlocked_description: You don't miss a landing anymore. Not once, not since the jump that shouldn't have worked.
playstyle: Action-chain skirmisher refined: a Wind-Cut Wound now keeps the target bleeding tempo it can't spare.

unlocked_description: Your shadow moves a beat before you do, most days. You've stopped trying to catch it doing that.
playstyle: Fusion ranger: the kit splits between fast Action shots and a Power-guarded leap.

unlocked_description: You cleared four towers in one jump last week. Nobody who saw it has fully explained it to themselves yet.
playstyle: Half-transformed skyrunner: a Monkey-God's Volley now catches every enemy across the field.

unlocked_description: The skybridges between towers don't feel far anymore. Nine years of running them will do that, apparently.
playstyle: Mastery tier: every shot lands with a monkey-god's aim, and the wind never seems to slow you.

unlocked_description: You don't run the skybridges anymore. Nine years on, when something impossible needs doing between two towers, people just say your name.
playstyle: Full avatar: a single Monkey-God's Verdict ends anything already caught mid-fall.

unlocked_description: The ink doesn't just sit on your skin anymore. It moves, sometimes, right before you do.
playstyle: Action-chain striker refined: a Cursed Yantra Wound now keeps draining whatever it marks.

unlocked_description: You stopped counting the tattoos a while ago. The ink stopped needing your permission to add more, too.
playstyle: Fusion striker: the kit splits between fast Action strikes and a Power-guarded ward stance.

unlocked_description: Your shadow has lines on it now, the same ones as your skin. You've stopped questioning who drew those.
playstyle: Half-transformed warrior: a Five-Row Reckoning now marks every enemy caught in range.

unlocked_description: The old shophouse where you got the first tattoo flooded over years ago. The ink doesn't need the shop anymore. It never really did.
playstyle: Mastery tier: every strike lands with a master's full weight, and the ink has stopped needing to be earned twice.

unlocked_description: You don't need new ink anymore. Nine years on, the sacred script covers you completely, and it's stopped being a metaphor.
playstyle: Full avatar: a single Master's Final Verdict ends anything already marked.

unlocked_description: The batches don't fail anymore, not the way they used to. They just... change, into something you didn't quite plan for.
playstyle: Volatile mixer refined: a Corroding Draft now keeps eating away at whatever it touches.

unlocked_description: You stopped needing the stall a while back. These days the reagents mostly find you.
playstyle: Fusion mixer: the kit splits between a Power-primed brew and a Spell cast the moment it's ready.

unlocked_description: Your veins glow faintly now, when the current under the city runs strong. You've stopped covering them up.
playstyle: Half-transformed mixer: a Catalytic Bloom now spreads across every enemy in the blast radius.

unlocked_description: The market stall is gone, washed out years ago. You don't need a stall. You are, more or less, the reaction now.
playstyle: Mastery tier: every brew lands harder, and the reagents never seem to run short anymore.

unlocked_description: You don't brew from the current anymore. Nine years on, the current under Bangkok just runs a little stronger wherever you're standing.
playstyle: Full avatar: a single Catalytic Verdict ends anything already destabilized.

unlocked_description: The current under the city doesn't feel like static anymore. It feels like something with an opinion, and it's started sharing them.
playstyle: Spell-chain telekinetic refined: a Fracturing Thought now keeps unraveling whatever it's aimed at.

unlocked_description: You stopped needing to concentrate to hear it a while ago. Now it's more like it's always half-talking, and you're half-listening back.
playstyle: Fusion psychic: the kit splits between Spell force and a Power-built mental ward.

unlocked_description: You don't always know anymore which thoughts started in your own head. Most days that stopped mattering.
playstyle: Half-transformed oracle: a Current's Verdict now unravels every enemy caught in its reach.

unlocked_description: The noise stopped being noise years ago. It's just conversation now, one you've been having for so long you've forgotten it started as static.
playstyle: Mastery tier: every thought lands with the current's full weight, and the resonance never seems to fade.

unlocked_description: You don't listen for the current anymore. Nine years on, when the current under Bangkok speaks, more often than not it's using your voice.
playstyle: Full avatar: a single Current's Final Word ends anything already fracturing.

unlocked_description: The sutras don't feel unfinished anymore. They feel like they were always going to end up complete, with or without a teacher to finish them.
playstyle: Spell-chain purifier refined: a Binding Sutra now keeps weakening whatever it's spoken over.

unlocked_description: You don't fully banish them anymore, not always. Sometimes you just ask what they need, and that works better than expected.
playstyle: Fusion exorcist: the kit splits between Spell purification and a Power-built boundary ward.

unlocked_description: You're not entirely on the living side of the boundary anymore, not fully. Neither are you entirely gone. It's a useful place to stand.
playstyle: Half-transformed khru: a Boundary's Judgment now purifies every threat caught between worlds.

unlocked_description: The old teacher's unfinished lesson plan doesn't feel unfinished anymore. You've been teaching yourself out of it for nine years, and it shows.
playstyle: Mastery tier: every rite lands with a completed ordination's full weight, and the boundary holds without strain.

unlocked_description: You don't guard the line between worlds anymore. Nine years on, wherever you're standing, that's just where the line is.
playstyle: Full avatar: a single Final Ordination ends anything still clinging to this side of the boundary.

unlocked_description: You don't need the 3 a.m. slot anymore. The signal answers whenever you reach for it now, day or night.
playstyle: Power-chain enabler refined: a Fading Frequency now keeps draining whatever it's tuned to.

unlocked_description: You stopped needing the transmitter's power source a while back. You're not sure what's powering it now, and you've stopped asking.
playstyle: Fusion herald: the kit splits between a Power-primed broadcast and a Spell burst it pays off.

unlocked_description: Half your voice doesn't sound like yours over the old emergency band anymore. People say it's clearer than it's ever been.
playstyle: Half-transformed herald: a Citywide Broadcast now reaches every threat in range at once.

unlocked_description: The dead station went off the air in 2026. Nine years later, it's never really stopped broadcasting. It just stopped needing the building.
playstyle: Mastery tier: every burst lands with a station's full power, and the signal never seems to fade.

unlocked_description: You don't need a transmitter anymore. Nine years on, you are the emergency band, and half the towers in Bangkok still tune in without knowing why.
playstyle: Full avatar: a single Final Broadcast ends anything already drowning in the noise.
